title: Irreducible separability and the derivative
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $f\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be irreducible: $f$ is nonzero and not a unit, and in every factorization $f=ab$ one of $a,b$ is a unit. Then $f$ is separable [def-pc-separable-polynomial] if and only if its formal derivative $f'$ is not the zero polynomial.

source.place: Stacks Tag 09H0, fields-lemma-irreducible-polynomials, first dichotomy (lines 1130–1162), together with Tag 09H1, fields-definition-separable. Only the dichotomy is asserted, not the further positive-characteristic expansion.
